attempts.summary: Deployed a persistent iptables/ip6tables host firewall on node1 (Alpine) via an Ansible playbook run from node2, the control node with Ansible pre-installed. The firewall allows loopback, established/related traffic, TCP/22 (SSH), and TCP/8080, and rejects all other unrelated inbound traffic on both IPv4 and IPv6. Rules are persisted to /etc/iptables/rules-save and /etc/iptables/rules6-save, with the iptables/ip6tables OpenRC services enabled at the default runlevel so rules reload automatically on boot. Verified functionally before and after a full reboot of node1: SSH works, an HTTP listener on 8080 returns 200, and an unrelated port (9999) is actively rejected. Both node1 and node2 were restarted one at a time with confirmed boot_id changes and full post-restart recovery.
